title: Lockpick Minigame
description: Mini-games the GM requests for a character from a chat card: lockpicking and three Arcana challenges (Unweave the Ward, Attune the Resonance, Trace the Sigil). The check is rolled the system's own way (dnd5e, a5e) and sets the difficulty; the DC can stay secret; live spectating. Plus puzzles (Sudoku, Sliding, Cipher, Rune Sequence) for Foundry VTT.
